ORBITAL PAD 04 // FLIGHT TEST MANUAL

🚀 Test Circuit Objectives

Initiate takeoff to watch the spaceship lift off vertically from Pad 04, retract its landing gear, navigate a local test circuit around the spaceport landmarks (solar array, radar overlook ridge, and cryogenic depot), then return and perform a feather-soft touchdown on the pad.

🎥 Camera & Visibility Controls

  • Track Ship (Default): Keeps the spaceship centered with dynamic framing while allowing you to orbit and zoom freely.
  • Chase Cam: Dynamic camera locked directly behind the ship's thrusters.
  • Tower Cam: View the entire flight circuit from the Flight Control Tower's panoramic deck.
  • Pad Orbit: Free inspection camera centered on Landing Pad 04.
  • Reset Button (⟲): Instantly snaps the camera back to optimal framing.

🕹️ Desktop & Mobile Navigation

  • One-Finger Drag / Left Click: Orbit camera around target.
  • Pinch / Scroll Wheel: Smooth zoom in and out.
  • Two-Finger Drag / Right Click: Pan view.
  • Speed Selector: Switch between 0.5x, 1.0x, and 2.0x playback speed.
